label: real_time_vintage_backtest_energy
honesty: Real-time backtest on EIA STEO archive vintages: at each origin only issues whose evidenced, conservative availability instant (day after the release date) is at/before the origin are used (available_then reconstruction; REVA did not exist at these origins). Inputs and STEO forecasts as published then; outcomes from EIA's current published history (final vintage of the target). STEO forecasts are EIA's, attributed; REVA's models are candidates scored against them. No futures prices are used.
outcome_basis: EIA STEO current published history (latest atlas.eia_steo.steo_observed: periods <= the series' declared lastHistoricalPeriod), i.e. the final vintage of the target month
